name: morphedra
description: Turn figures into narrated whiteboard videos with Morphedra, from inside Claude.
long_description: Create narrated whiteboard videos from your own figures (PNG, JPG or WEBP), follow their progress, list your videos, cancel queued ones and check your balance and usage. Needs a Morphedra API key (mk_live_... or mk_test_...). Test keys are free and add a watermark; live keys are billed at $1.80 per minute of finished video.

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Create a narrated whiteboard video from 1 to 6 figures (spends money on live keys).

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Get the status, progress and result of a video, optionally waiting for it to finish.

tools.name: cancel_video
tools.description: Cancel a video that is still queued.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Show the prepaid balance and free test videos left.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show usage totals for the last 1 to 90 days.

api_key.title: Morphedra API key
api_key.description: Your API key, starting with mk_live_ or mk_test_. It is stored in your computer's secret store.
